summary: Cummins Inc. reported a 3% revenue growth in Q1 2026, driven by a 23% surge in North American power generation demand. The company raised its full-year revenue guidance to 8%-11% and adjusted EPS to $6.15, outperforming estimates by 9.8%. The most significant recent development this week appears to be the Q1 2026 earnings announcement, which showed strong performance particularly in the power generation segment in North America, along with improved full-year guidance from the company.
